title: Missed row on the board
summary: The board gains a ninth, full-width row like a departure board: a red X flap and the missed words in flap letters ('MIMO TABULI · AUTO · MOBIL'), flipping as misses arrive; it stays visible after the game.
tradeoffs: Makes the board one row taller on every screen; on a phone the words are set smaller and five long misses could be clipped at the edge.
